summary: Explains that a WinRM listener must exist on the Windows host and gives a PowerShell snippet that enables PSRemoting, opens TCP 5985 in the firewall, and sets LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy for local accounts.
questions: How do I quickly set up WinRM on a Windows host for Ansible?
Which port does WinRM HTTP use?
How do I let local admin accounts connect over WinRM?
What PowerShell commands prepare a Windows box for Ansible?

answer_card.title: Quick WinRM HTTP listener setup
answer_card.answer_md:
Run on the Windows host:

```powershell
Enable-PSRemoting -Force

New-NetFirewallRule -Action Allow -Direction Inbound -DisplayName 'Windows Remote Management (HTTP-In)' -LocalPort 5985 -Profile Any -Protocol TCP

# Only needed for local (non-domain) accounts
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System' -Name LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy -Value 1 -PropertyType DWORD -Force
```
